Müşterime SMS gider mi?: Will my customer get an SMS?
Hayır. Otomasyonlar yalnız uygulama içi: No. Automations only send in-app notifications and are free. Appointment confirmation/reminder SMS are managed separately in “SMS settings”.
Yalnız Senin Randevun uygulamasında hesa: They only reach customers who booked with an account in the Senin Randevun app and allowed notifications. Guests who booked without an account don't receive them.
Kuralı örnek bilgilerle (Örnek Müşteri,: It runs the rule with sample details (Sample Customer, Sample service). The notification comes only to you; nothing is sent to the customer and the counter doesn't increase.
Personelim kuralları görebilir mi?: Can my staff see the rules?
Personel kuralları ve son çalışmaları gö: Staff can see rules and recent runs but can't change them. If team notifications are on, they only get those related to their own appointments.
Paketimi düşürürsem ne olur?: What happens if I downgrade my plan?
Otomasyon içermeyen bir pakete geçerseni: If you switch to a plan without automations, your rules aren't deleted; they just stop running. When you upgrade again, they pick up where they left off.
“{name}” otomasyonu kalıcı olarak silini: The “{name}” automation will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone. If you only want to stop it, just turn off the switch.
